title: Grade 8 Science — Tue, Jun 17
description: Coal and Petroleum — Day 2 of 5: Uses of coal — coke, coal tar, coal gas
subject: science

questions.question: When coal is processed (destructive distillation), which three major products are obtained?
options: Coke, coal tar, and coal gas
questions.explanation: Destructive distillation of coal yields three main products: Coke (solid), Coal tar (thick black liquid), and Coal gas (gaseous mixture).

questions.question: Coke is produced from coal and is used primarily for:
options: Making steel (reduction of iron ore in blast furnaces)
questions.explanation: Coke is a hard porous carbon fuel used in blast furnaces to smelt iron ore into iron and steel. It burns at very high temperatures.

questions.question: Coal tar is a thick, dark liquid. Which useful material obtained from coal tar is used to surface roads?
questions.explanation: Bitumen (asphalt) is obtained from coal tar and is used to surface roads and waterproof structures.

questions.question: Coal gas is used as:
options: A fuel for cooking and heating (historically)
A raw material for making plastics
questions.explanation: Coal gas (mixture of hydrogen, methane, and carbon monoxide) was historically used as a fuel for cooking, heating, and street lighting before natural gas became available.

questions.question: Naphthalene balls (used to repel insects) are made from:
questions.explanation: Naphthalene is a product derived from coal tar. It is used to make mothballs/naphthalene balls that repel insects.

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a product obtained from coal tar?
questions.explanation: Diesel is obtained from petroleum refining, not coal tar. Coal tar products include synthetic dyes, perfumes, pesticides, explosives, and naphthalene.

questions.question: Before the discovery of synthetic dyes, what was used to dye fabrics?
questions.explanation: Before coal tar-based synthetic dyes were discovered (mid-1800s), fabrics were dyed using natural plant-based dyes (indigo, madder) and mineral dyes.

questions.question: Coke is different from charcoal because:
options: Coke is made from wood; charcoal from coal
Coke is made from coal; charcoal is made from wood
Coke is a liquid; charcoal is a gas
questions.explanation: Coke is made from coal (by destructive distillation). Charcoal is made from wood (by burning in limited air). Both are forms of nearly pure carbon.

questions.question: The process of heating coal in the absence of air to produce coke is called:
questions.explanation: Destructive distillation = heating coal in the absence of air. This produces coke, coal tar, and coal gas as products.

questions.question: Which product of coal is used in the manufacturing of synthetic fibres, medicines, dyes, and explosives?
questions.explanation: Coal tar is a rich source of organic compounds used as raw materials for making synthetic fibres, medicines, dyes, pesticides, and explosives.

questions.question: Coal gas was first used for street lighting in:
questions.explanation: Coal gas was first used for street lighting in London in the early 1800s, replacing oil lamps.

questions.question: Why is coke preferred over coal in blast furnaces for iron smelting?
options: Coke burns at higher temperatures and produces less smoke than coal
questions.explanation: Coke burns more efficiently at higher temperatures with less smoke and impurities than coal, making it ideal for high-temperature smelting in blast furnaces.

questions.question: Which of the following comes from coal tar and is used as a medicine/antiseptic?
questions.explanation: Carbolic acid (phenol) was one of the first antiseptics, derived from coal tar. It was used by Joseph Lister in surgery.

questions.question: What environmental problem is caused by burning large amounts of coal?
options: Air pollution (SO₂, CO₂, particulate matter), acid rain, and global warming
questions.explanation: Burning coal releases SO₂ (causes acid rain), CO₂ (global warming), and particulate matter (air pollution). Coal burning is a major environmental concern.

questions.question: Which is the correct order of coal processing to get its three main products?
options: Coal → fractional distillation → petrol + diesel + kerosene
Coal → destructive distillation → coke + coal tar + coal gas
questions.explanation: Coal undergoes destructive distillation (heating without air) to yield: Coke (solid carbon), Coal tar (liquid), and Coal gas (gaseous mixture).
